user.title: Connect to the eufy bridge
user.description: Enter the host and port of your ha-eufy-sdk bridge (the WebSocket).

twofa.title: Two-factor authentication
twofa.description: A verification code was sent to your eufy account. Enter it below (tick Resend to request a new one).

captcha.title: Captcha
captcha.description:
Enter the characters from the image below (tick Refresh for a new one).

{image}

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate the eufy bridge
reauth_confirm.description: The bridge at {host} needs to log in again (its session expired, so eufy is asking for 2FA/captcha). Make sure the bridge is running and reachable, then submit to continue.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the bridge at that host/port.
error.invalid_2fa: That verification code was not accepted.

init.title: eufy bridge options
init.description: How often the bridge polls the eufy cloud for device state. Lower is fresher but adds cloud traffic; the cloud itself only updates every few minutes.

preset_empty.message: Preset {slot} has no stored position — aim the camera and press Save preset first.
